character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A clean 48x48 pixel-art humanoid base rig for a top-down roguelike arena shooter. A neutral modular blank character/mannequin with a bald simple head and blank face plane, no hair, no helmet, no armor, no clothing accessories, no weapon, no backpack, no cape. Separate readable arms, hands, legs, and feet; feet must be visibly distinct for real walk cycles. Empty hands and a consistent right-hand weapon attachment socket. Compact athletic proportions, about 2.5 heads tall, centered consistent silhouette in every direction. Mostly white and light-to-dark neutral grayscale ramps designed for deterministic programmatic recoloring, with only tiny protected dark outline/accent regions. Crisp deliberately placed pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, transparent background, no cast shadow. The same exact character identity and proportions in all views.
